text_block_list.text: The day of the Japanese Derby, the second leg of the Classic races, had finally arrived.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Just the fact that it's the Derby
makes the whole atmosphere feel different...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Like, the tension is super tight,
or maybe it's just heavy and oppressive...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"C-Come on! I'm not nervous at all!
Okay, maybe just a tiny bit!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: "I did tons of tandem training, so there's no way I'm gonna lose!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna surpass the Prez, so I can't afford to drag my feet here!
choice_data_list: Let's show off the results of your hard work!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I'm heading out!
I'll definitely, definitely come back with a win!
